claim_boundary: held out from v1.3 prompt, feature-weight, and case tuning; controlled text errors only; not a blinded dataset release, natural-error frequency study, multimodal evaluation, or human-repair study
researcher_blinding: not guaranteed because the public FinanceBench metadata and answers are locally available; no listed PDF was visually audited or run through the QA/policy pipeline before this protocol was frozen

eligible_document_rule: at least three released single-document questions whose evidence entries all name the same document
exclude every Boeing document and every entity used in v1.0-v1.3 development: Boeing, AMCOR, Best Buy, and AMD
source.document_ranking: ascending SHA-256 hex of source_commit + ':' + doc_name
source.question_selection: within each selected document, sort eligible financebench_id lexicographically and take the first three
source.replacement_rule: do not replace a selected question or document because retrieval, QA, candidate generation, repair, or policy behavior is poor; source corruption or unresolved reference conflict is retained and excluded only from the primary effect denominator with an explicit count

method_fixed_from_development.secondary_parser: PyMuPDF 1.28.2 numeric tokens and word geometry
method_fixed_from_development.qa_model: llama3:latest with immutable digest checked at execution
method_fixed_from_development.pipeline: deterministic passthrough, document-isolated BM25 top-k=6, quantitative_v2 prompt, temperature=0, context=8192, max output=700
method_fixed_from_development.anomaly_score: 0.70*binary numeric-token-count disagreement + 0.30*maximum normalized residual of an applicable predeclared statement identity
method_fixed_from_development.unavailable_feature_rule: an unavailable row/column or accounting identity feature is null/zero with availability recorded; it is not inferred from gold
method_fixed_from_development.ideal_fix_assumption: exact repair after an injected error is selected; not a human success probability

reference_audit.timing: after this protocol freeze and before model execution
reference_audit.conflict_rule: retain the question and conflict record; withhold unconditional correctness and main-effect inclusion until adjudicated
reference_audit.policy_visibility: none of the reference audit, evidence annotations, or conflict labels enters candidate generation or selection

controlled_error_generation.timing: after reference audit and before policy execution, without observing any model or policy outcome on these documents
controlled_error_generation.candidate_base: all primary-parser numeric spans on the complete damaged documents, including normal spans
eligible_injection: numeric span lies in a released evidence page and participates in a source-audited extraction or calculation route
one internal digit is deleted while leaving a syntactically numeric nonempty span
choice is the lowest SHA-256 of question_id:block_id:start among eligible spans for that question
at most one injected span per question and at most two per document
controlled_error_generation.non_effect_rule: do not require the corruption to change a model answer; duplicate/alternate routes and unchanged answers are retained
controlled_error_generation.miss_rule: if no eligible span exists or the corrupted span is absent from the full candidate universe, retain the question as injection/candidate miss and do not replace it
controlled_error_generation.nature: post-extraction controlled digit deletion; never report as natural parser error

policies.common_input: same frozen candidates, observable features, estimated provenance edges, unit costs, and budget
policies.individual_vs_graph: same anomaly and ideal-fix inputs; only Graph-aware discounts marginal downstream-question overlap with already selected candidates
policies.tie_break: ascending candidate_id; report every selection decided by an ID tie
policies.oracle: actual repair effect is forbidden from selection and may appear only as an explicitly labeled post-selection reference

cost_and_budget.budget_interpretation: one and two inspected spans per document on average; no human-time claim

executions.clean_general: one fresh document-isolated execution per document
executions.clean_oracle: one fresh per-question diagnostic, excluded from system performance
executions.targeted_states: clean, damaged, each eligible individual repair, and simultaneous repair; every state is fresh and uncached
executions.policy_states: one fresh downstream execution per policy-budget pair
executions.failure_rule: failed, missing, unparseable, unsupported, or unreviewed results are not successes

selection: graph overlap estimate versus observed repair overlap

reporting_slices.overall_deployment_like: all nine frozen questions including candidate misses, retrieval failures, non-repairs, and identical selected sets
reporting_slices.conditional: questions whose injected error is present in the frozen candidate universe; report alongside, never instead of overall

metrics.uncertainty: document-clustered intervals or exact paired randomization only if the achieved sample supports them; otherwise raw counts and explicit small-sample limitation

required_before_performance_run: source PDFs and parser snapshots preserved with checksums
all nine reference/evidence pairs audited without changing the list
injection and candidate manifests serialized before selections
at least one observable feature has nonzero variation
different downstream dependency structures are present; otherwise run may proceed only as a recorded null-structure diagnostic, not a graph-policy test
